subject: reasoning
question: If 11 July 2020 was Monday, what will be 14 October 2028?
solution:
Given: 11 July 2020 was Monday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Here, 11 July 2020 has been given as Monday - this does not match the original weekday of this date. Hence, the day on 14 October 2028 is also not similar to the original weekday.
 
• Therefore, 14 October 2028 will not be a Saturday if 11 July 2020 is a Monday.

So, 11 July to 14 October = 20(July) + 31(Aug) + 30(Sep) + 14(Oct) 

= 95 days = 95/7 = 13 weeks and 4 odd days.

So, 14 October 2020 = Monday + 4 = Friday.

Now, 

14 October 2020 to 14 October 2028 = 8 Years.

 
 

 Normal Year
 1 Odd day
 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd day
 
 

 

8 Years (6 Ordinary Year + 2 Leap Year) = 6 + 4 = 10 odd days.

10 odd days = 10/7 = 1 week 3 odd days.

So, 14 October 2028 = Friday + 3 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Monday"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

Year : 2028 - 2020 = 8 years + 2 leap years = 10 years , **odd days = 3 **

 Month: July-3, Aug-3, Sep-2 = 8 , **odd days =1** (Oct will not be counted)

Date: 22-14 = 8, **odd days = 1**

total odd days = 3 + 1 + 1 = 5 , **odd days = 0**

Therefore, **Monday + 0 = Monday** 

Hence, **the correct answer is Monday.**
